questions.question: Which declaration gives a variable block scope and allows reassignment?
questions.explanation: let is block-scoped and permits reassignment. const prevents reassignment; var is scoped to a function or the surrounding script.

questions.question: Declaring an object with const prevents changes to its properties.
questions.explanation: const protects the binding. Object properties remain mutable unless you apply other restrictions.
map transforms every element into a new array. It does not change scores.

questions.question: Why can an object's properties change when its binding uses const?
questions.answer: The binding and the object are separate. const prevents assigning a different value to the variable, but does not make the referenced object immutable.
